notes: Read all 453 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; behaviour, state names, API paths, unit handling, i18n keys+defaults, and the page's section structure (banner -> selectors -> AI narration -> metric cards -> bar chart -> table -> insights) are preserved. The native file header documents every web->native remap.
L1 `import { useEffect, useMemo, useState }`: kept; the native file also pulls React + useCallback/useRef/ReactNode for the inlined component shims.

L2 react-router-dom Link: not in the native manifest (no router/URL on bare native) -> the fleet-comparison CTA becomes an accessibilityRole='link' Pressable styled with the underline+accent link look; navigation target is unavailable in this parity surface (documented).

L3 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined useNativeTranslation(): a stable (key, fallback, options?) => fallback shim reproducing i18next `{{name}}` interpolation against the English fallback copy. Every t('key','English'[,opts]) keeps its English default so i18n intent is preserved at each call site (the insights rely on the interpolation).
L4 @tanstack/react-query useQuery: imported from the same package the native app already depends on; both period-stats queries are ported verbatim.

L5-7 lucide-react Car/Calendar/TrendingUp/Zap/Gauge/DollarSign/Leaf/Lightbulb/ArrowLeftRight: -> SemanticIcon glyphs (calendar for EmptyState, lightbulb for the Insights header, arrowLeftRight + close for the banner) plus per-metric 2-char colour-chip glyphs (EV/UP/ZP/EF/$/LF) inside the inline MetricCard, mirroring how SemanticIcon itself renders 2-char glyphs.

L9 @/components/layout PageContainer -> inline native PageContainer: title (variant=title) + subtitle (muted caption) + the web loading (ActivityIndicator spinner) / error (danger banner showing error.message) / children branches reproduced one-for-one; children render only when not loading and not errored, exactly like the web.

L10 @/components/ui GlassPanel/Badge/Select(+SelectOption)/DataTable(+Column): GlassPanel -> the existing native GlassPanel; Badge -> inline native Badge (success/danger surfaces+text over tokens, used by the %-change column); Select+SelectOption -> inline native chip-row Select (label + horizontal ScrollView of option Pressables; onValueChange preserves the web onChange(e=>e.target.value) contract); DataTable+Column -> inline native ComparisonTable (horizontal-scroll header+rows driven by the same Column render fns) plus a re-declared Column<T> type; the web `sortable` flag is honoured with tap-to-sort headers (numeric/string compare), `compact`+`pagination` collapse to a single page for the fixed 6-metric set.

L11 @/components/data-display MetricCard -> inline native MetricCard (label, value, colour-chip glyph icon, subtitle, ↑/↓ emerald/rose change pill) matching the web card layout; `color` (cyan/green/purple) drives the icon chip bg/border/text via a native neon map.

L12 @/components/feedback Skeleton/EmptyState/AlertBanner: Skeleton -> inline native Skeleton (N placeholder bars, lines=6); EmptyState -> inline native EmptyState (SemanticIcon calendar icon + message); AlertBanner -> inline native dismissible AlertBanner (info surface, leading icon, body, close Pressable).
L13 @/components/motion FadeIn -> Animated.View opacity 0->1 mount fade with stop() cleanup; the web `delay` (0.025/0.05/0.1/0.15/0.2s) maps to Animated delay (delay*1000 ms).

L14-18 @/components/charts Recharts (ChartTooltip/BarChart/Bar/XAxis/YAxis/CartesianGrid/Tooltip/ResponsiveContainer/Legend + chartMarginLabeled/axisTick/chartAnimation): -> inline native ComparisonBarChart, a grouped horizontal bar chart. Each metric draws Period-A and Period-B bars coloured from the user palette (palette[0]/palette[1]) with a legend (Period A/Period B) and explicit fmtNumber value labels. Bars are normalised to each metric's own max so both series stay legible on a phone while the printed values keep the data exact (Recharts' shared linear axis would render most bars invisibly small on mobile). No Recharts/SVG import.
L20 @/api/hooks/useVehicles useVehicles: imported from the already-ported native hook ../../../api/hooks/useVehicles (same '/vehicles' path via the shared request() client; data is Vehicle[]).

L21 @/hooks/usePageTitle -> native-safe usePageTitle(): feature-detects document.title (present on react-native-web, absent on bare native) and writes '{title} — TeslaSync', restoring the prior title on unmount.

L22 @/hooks/useChartPalette -> inlined useChartPalette(): reads chart_palette from the ported useSettings and resolveChartPalette('neon' -> neon, else cb-safe), with CHART_COLORS_CB_SAFE / CHART_COLORS_NEON ported verbatim from @/lib/colors.

There is no URL on bare native, so query-string persistence is intentionally dropped (documented).

Native-safe browser-only behaviour (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) window.localStorage for the banner dismissal is feature-detected (present on react-native-web, absent on bare native); when absent the dismissal is in-memory only. (b) document.title for usePageTitle is feature-detected. (c) The react-router-dom Link/URL state is replaced with in-memory state + a non-navigating link-styled Pressable, since there is no browser URL or router on this parity surface.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, react-router-dom, lucide-react, Recharts, or Leaflet are imported — only react, react-native primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/Animated/ActivityIndicator/StyleSheet), @tanstack/react-query, the ported web-parity api client + useVehicles/useSettings hooks + AIPeriodCompareNarration, and the existing apps/native SemanticIcon/AppText/GlassPanel/theme tokens.
